closure_rationale.schema_version: parent freezes the field but not its exact representation
closure_rationale.binding_generation: parent freezes the field but not initial generation or successor semantics
closure_rationale.timestamp: parent does not select operation binding UTC precision or freeze exact UUIDv7 timestamp correspondence
closure_rationale.purpose_domain: parent names operation purpose domain but does not select its reservation digest use; purpose does not derive UUID bits
closure_rationale.durable_lifecycle: parent requires durable reservation and immutable binding but does not freeze reservation identity digest, exact-byte retry or capability restoration

canonicalization.canonical_utc: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ; exactly three fractional digits, real Gregorian UTC date, no offset or leap seconds

binding_artifact.digest: lowercase hex SHA256(exact canonical payload bytes)
binding_artifact.created_at_utc: one internally captured actual UTC reservation instant floored to milliseconds, retained before native signing and encoded with exactly three fractional digits; exact UUIDv7 timestamp equality is required

operation_identity.uuid_timestamp: unsigned 48-bit floor(actual captured internal UTC reservation Unix epoch milliseconds); integer timedelta arithmetic, no float rounding, no uint48 masking, no whole-second truncation before UUID issuance
operation_identity.uuid_randomness: CSPRNG 12-bit rand_a and 62-bit rand_b; version 7 and RFC variant 10
operation_identity.created_at_uuid_timestamp_match: decode UUIDv7 timestamp and compare with the exact millisecond instant in created_at_utc

reservation_identity.digest: lowercase hex SHA256(UTF8("CryptoHunter.Stage9.ProvisioningOperation.v1") || 0x00 || JCS_UTF8(exact canonical reservation tuple))
reservation_identity.first_winner: one initial installed authority lifecycle admits one durable reservation; never create parallel operation IDs for the same initial flow
reservation_identity.retry: exact trust/package/subject/enrollment/ACTIVE authority tuple returns or durably resumes the same prvop
reservation_identity.conflicting_retry: different trust domain, package, subject, enrollment or ACTIVE authority rejects without mutating or replacing the first reservation

source_bindings.pdsa_trust_domain: exact verified production lineage behind current ACTIVE LPPI authority
source_bindings.pdsa_package_digest_sha256: exact retained PDSA package behind current ACTIVE LPPI authority
source_bindings.provisioning_subject_id: exact retained package behind current ACTIVE LPPI authority
source_bindings.enrollment_reference: exact retained package behind current ACTIVE LPPI authority

signature_profile.signature_encoding: strict minimal ASN.1 DER SEQUENCE(INTEGER r, INTEGER low-S s)
signature_profile.exact_signer: exact currently verified native ACTIVE LPPI successor private key; immutable ACTIVE binding and live CNG/TPM identity are requalified

production_signing_boundary.input: exact canonical LPPIAuthenticatedProvisioningOperationBindingV1 bytes plus current ACTIVE LPPI authority capability
production_signing_boundary.before_each_consequential_sign: requalify current ACTIVE capability, native key profile/fingerprint/custody and exact binding enrollment/package; require exact durably reserved payload and private current-process/current-thread signing-lock owner; status ACTIVE alone is insufficient

durable_lifecycle.storage_representation: exact immutable canonical payload and authority binding joins may supply duplicate semantic fields; JSON alone is never authority
durable_lifecycle.concurrency: cross-process lock plus one immutable initial reservation; racing caller observes retained reservation/result or busy/retry, never a second prvop
durable_lifecycle.signature_retention: verify and durably retain the first accepted exact DER before publication; after commit never sign again
durable_lifecycle.immutability: after commit the exact payload, package/subject/enrollment/prvop, generation, timestamp, signature and signer identity cannot change

crash_retry.outcome: safe fresh reservation or fail-closed; no identifier published
resume same durable prvop and exact canonical payload
fail-closed or retry same reserved identity; uncommitted signature is not authority
may resign exact retained payload only when no prior result was published or established as authority
return exact retained payload and signature bytes without resigning
restore/reverify ACTIVE successor, exact retained operation and signature; never remint

durable_lifecycle.transient_signing_stage: BINDING_SIGNED is in memory only; it cannot be published before authenticated operation commit

storage.locks: nonblocking cross-process singleton; state lock only reserve/finalize, signing lock encloses costly requalification and native sign

operation_capability.issuer: trusted retained operation verifier after durable authenticated operation commit
operation_capability.each_use: current ACTIVE requalification plus retained state exact-match, signature revalidation and exact package/subject/enrollment/prvop tuple
